paragraphs: Rav Yehudah bar Achitai, Keritot 13b; Rav Shmuel bar Achitai, Sukkah 42a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Keritot13b in the William Davidson edition reads Yehudah bar Achotai (אחותאי), against the heading Achitai (אחיתאי). The shortened patronymics in Hyman are expanded from his heading; the spelling difference is preserved here.

The William Davidson digital text of Keritot 13b has Rav Yehudah bar Achotai (אחותאי); the complete Sukkah 42a text read here instead has Rav Shmuel bar Hattai (חתאי). Hyman’s heading Achitai and both heading-based expansions of ב״א are retained as his forms, without repairing the Hebrew, identifying the fathers, or claiming that the Sukkah digital patronymic matches.
